content.text:
I fixed the redirect handling in `packages/playwright-core/src/server/fetch.ts`. I haven't built or run anything, so it's untested.

The redirect code checked `headers['host']` with an exact lowercase key. A header written as `Host` or `HOST` never matched, so the old host was kept after the redirect.

The check is now case-insensitive. If any header name matches `host` in any casing, the code removes it with the existing `removeHeader` helper. It then sets `headers['host']` to the redirect target's host.

result:
I fixed the redirect handling in `packages/playwright-core/src/server/fetch.ts`. I haven't built or run anything, so it's untested.

The redirect code checked `headers['host']` with an exact lowercase key. A header written as `Host` or `HOST` never matched, so the old host was kept after the redirect.

The check is now case-insensitive. If any header name matches `host` in any casing, the code removes it with the existing `removeHeader` helper. It then sets `headers['host']` to the redirect target's host.
